summary.text: Thomas Stevens, a Democrat from Waterbury, has represented Washington-Chittenden in the Vermont House of Representatives since 2009.
He sits on the House Committee on Appropriations.

paragraphs.text: Stevens was born in New Haven, Connecticut, moved to Waterbury in 1996, and graduated from Boston University with a bachelor's degree in fine arts, according to his House biography.
He has served as chair of the Waterbury Select Board and president of the Waterbury Village Trustees.
He served eight years on the board of Downstreet Housing and Community Development, four as president, and was executive director of the Vermont Alliance for Arts Education.
He has also been director and production coordinator for QuarryWorks Theater at the Adamant Music School.
